params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. Results:

It also updates all usages of these fields to use the new accessor methods, ensuring encapsulation is respected. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; the modifications are focused solely on fixing the warning with minimal impact on unrelated code. The only minor issue is a missing setter usage in the last method (withW3cDocument), but this does not detract from the overall correctness of the patch in fixing the warning.
